title: Endpoint Network Connectivity Troubleshooting Toolkit (DNS, Proxy, VPN, IP/Port/URL Filtering)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (cross-domain endpoint troubleshooting/operations; diagnostic method + scripts, live-environment care).
Vendor/product-specific console internals are deferred to the vendor's official documentation; the Intune/Entra/Windows side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
hook: Isolate why the endpoint can't reach the service — layer by layer
problem: “It works on my machine” hides a stack of possible causes: DNS, proxy/PAC, VPN, or an IP/Port/URL filter silently blocking the traffic. This vendor-neutral toolkit gives you a layered root-cause method and diagnostic scripts to test each layer from the endpoint — name resolution, proxy, VPN tunnel, and access-control filters — so you prove where the block is instead of guessing.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the endpoint-to-service path (DNS → proxy/PAC → VPN → firewall/URL filter → service) and the layered model behind the root-cause tree.
Requirements Guide — what you need to diagnose (endpoint access, network/proxy details, test targets) with how to verify each.
Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom tree (name won't resolve, resolves-can't-connect, proxy/PAC misroute, VPN split-tunnel gap, IP:Port blocked, URL category blocked) with the exact checks per layer.

5 PowerShell scripts — connectivity/DNS/proxy discovery, per-endpoint reachability validation (name/IP/port/URL), a connectivity coverage report, safe local remediation (cache/route/proxy reset), and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides mapping each pass/fail gate to the responsible layer, plus Best Practices for repeatable network triage and escalation with evidence.
short: A vendor-neutral, endpoint-side root-cause method and scripts to isolate connectivity failures across DNS, proxy/PAC, VPN, and IP/Port/URL filtering — prove where the block is. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
